webPolicy.summary: Yes opens only the verified Save for the current unsaved memory capture the panel presents; outcome 'load-save', never 'load-allowed'; no picker, no chooser, no grant; disabled with a reason without Save support; no discard fallback.

Only the flow's own attempt token with a genuine current receipt of the flow's data object and generation, with the attempt's file name and not the prior written value, makes the flow ready. The saved flag is never the load authority.
Separate Load choice dialog, Cancel default; nothing loaded automatically; under a foreign modal it waits.

Fresh Choose click; flushSync mounts a dedicated input keyed by (flowId, invocation) and clicks it with no await; change and cancel handlers capture their own tuple; empty selection or standard cancel consumes the grant; window blur never cancels.

Shared strict reader; obsolete flow continuations are silent; own context loss fails as superseded; one synchronous commit: import rechecked inside the shared update, then the own flow ends, adoption, ordinary pulsarLoad.
Save Cancel, bad read, Cancel reading, hide, busy or context change end the flow with no automatic replacement; the old dedicated input stays invalid; ordinary Load rules apply afterwards.
Flow recognised by every handler through refs; output claims unchanged and released only after cleanup.
Hide/busy/unmount end the flow; a running Save keeps its abandoned notice as a standalone Save.
